description: Build an eSIM plan to the traveller's liking for one destination: how much data, for how many days, optionally which network it runs on and whether calls and texts are bundled. Returns the one real plan that matches, with its id and live price, never a made-up combination: a shape nobody sells is snapped to the nearest one that is, one axis at a time, and every change is spelled out in `adjustments` so you can read it back. Use it when the traveller knows what they want ("10 GB on Docomo for two weeks"); use plan-trip when they want a recommendation or the trip has several countries. To buy, pass `plan.id` to get-checkout-link when a person is paying, or to create-checkout-session when you are. Read-only: it reserves nothing and charges nothing.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the destination, e.g. "JP". Look it up with list-destinations rather than guessing.

currency.description: Optional. ISO 4217 three-letter code the price is quoted in, e.g. "USD", "EUR", "GBP". Defaults to EUR. An unknown code falls back to EUR rather than failing.

data_mb.description: Data allowance wanted, in megabytes: 1 GB is 1024 MB, so 5 GB is 5120. Pass 0 for an unlimited plan. Snapped to the nearest size sold when no plan has exactly this size.

network.description: Optional. The mobile network the plan should run on, by carrier name as `options.networks` lists them, e.g. "NTT Docomo" or "au". Matching is case-insensitive and a single carrier of a multi-network plan is enough. Omit for the cheapest network.

validity_days.description: How many days the plan should stay valid, 1 to 365. Snapped to the nearest length sold for the chosen size.

voice.description: Optional. True to require a plan that bundles calls and texts. Defaults to false, data only. If no such plan exists the answer is data only and says so.

name: build-plan

adjustments.description: Every way the built plan differs from what was asked, one sentence each, written to be read to the traveller. Empty when the plan matches the request exactly.

built.description: The specification of the plan actually built, after any adjustment. Null when nothing was found.

data_mb.description: The data size of the plan built, in megabytes; 0 means unlimited.

network.description: The network of the plan built, or null for any network.

validity_days.description: The length of the plan built, in days.

voice.description: Whether calls and texts are bundled of the plan built.

found.description: True when a plan was built. False when the destination sells nothing at all, in which case `plan` is null.

options.description: What else could be asked for, so a follow-up question can be answered without another call.

data_mb.description: Every data size sold for the destination, in megabytes, metered ascending and 0 (unlimited) last.

networks.description: Every network the destination is sold on. Empty when no plan names its carrier.

network.description: The value to pass as `network` to choose this one.

network_generation.description: The fastest generation any plan on this network states. Null when none states one: not stated, not any generation.

validity_days.description: Every length sold for the size that was built, in days.

voice.description: True when at least one plan bundles calls and texts.

plan.description: The plan built: the same shape get-plan returns. Its `id` is what you buy with. Null when nothing was found.

carrier.description: The mobile network this plan runs on, when we can name it. Null when we cannot.

country.description: The one country this plan is filed under. Null for a regional or worldwide plan.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the from_price_cents beside it is expressed in, which is the currency you asked for, e.g. "EUR". Null exactly when from_price_cents is null, which is what a country nested on a plan answers: nothing priced it there.

from_price_cents.description: Cheapest plan for this destination, in minor units (cents) of the response currency, so 1250 is 12.50. Null when this response did not price the destination.

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "ES". This is the code list-plans and plan-trip take.

path.description: Path on the storefront, e.g. "/esim/spain/". Always the canonical page, never a redirect.

query.description: Query parameters that belong on the path, as an object. Empty when there are none.

url.description: The full storefront URL for this country's storefront page. Safe to show to a person.

region.description: The region this country is filed under, e.g. "Europe". Null when it is filed under none.

coverage_countries.description: Every country the plan works in.

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or null for a country we could not match to a code.

operators.description: Networks in that country, when the country could be attributed. Empty means not attributed, never "no coverage".

coverage_type.description: Scope of the plan: one country, a region, or worldwide.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code retail_price_cents is quoted in, e.g. "EUR".

data_amount_mb.description: Data allowance in megabytes (1 GB is 1024 MB). 0 on an unlimited plan, where data_usage_policy carries the real terms.

data_restriction_type.description: Whether the allowance is capped ("limited") or unmetered ("unlimited").

data_usage_policy.description: What the plan really gives you. Null when the supplier has never published its terms, which is different from having no limits.

high_speed_data_mb.description: Full-speed allowance in megabytes PER RESET PERIOD, so 1 GB a day for 30 days is 1024, not 30720. 0 means genuinely uncapped.

max_speed_kbps.description: Speed ceiling in kbit/s from the first megabyte. Null means no ceiling.

reduced_speed_kbps.description: Speed in kbit/s after the full-speed allowance is used. Null means the data STOPS rather than slowing down.

reset_period.description: How often the full-speed allowance resets. Null means it covers the whole plan.

excluded_countries.description: Countries in this plan's own region that it does NOT cover. Always empty for a country plan and for a worldwide one.

hotspot_usage_policy.description: What the plan lets you do with a hotspot. Null when the terms were never established, which is different from being allowed.

allowed.description: Whether the plan may be shared as a hotspot at all.

high_speed_data_mb.description: A separate tethering allowance in megabytes per reset period. Null means tethering draws on the plan data with no allowance of its own.

max_speed_kbps.description: Speed ceiling in kbit/s while tethering. Null means no ceiling.

max_total_mb.description: A hard cap on tethered data across the whole plan, in megabytes. Null means no such cap.

reduced_speed_kbps.description: Speed in kbit/s once the tethering allowance is used. Null means tethering stops.

reset_period.description: How often the tethering allowance resets. Null when it covers the whole plan.

id.description: The plan id (a 26-character ULID). Pass it to get-plan, get-plan-coverage or create-checkout-session. Never invent one.

is_worldwide.description: True when the plan is sold as a worldwide bundle.

links.description: Where a person buys this plan on simfuse.app.

country.description: The country page on its own, or null when the plan has no single country.

path.description: Path on the storefront, e.g. "/esim/spain/". Always the canonical page, never a redirect.

query.description: Query parameters that belong on the path, as an object. Empty when there are none.

url.description: The full storefront URL for the plan's country page. Safe to show to a person.

path.description: Path on the storefront, e.g. "/esim/spain/". Always the canonical page, never a redirect.

query.description: Query parameters that belong on the path, as an object. Empty when there are none.

url.description: The full storefront URL for the page this plan is bought on, with the plan preselected. Safe to show to a person.

name.description: Plan name as a traveller sees it, e.g. "Spain 5GB".

network.description: The network name as plain text, or null when unknown.

network_generation.description: The network generation the plan is sold as, exactly as stated for it. Null means not stated, which is not the same as any generation; say "not stated" rather than assuming.

network_type.description: Deprecated two-valued form: "5G" for a 5G plan, "LTE" for everything else including plans whose generation was never stated. Read network_generation.

operators.description: Network operators the plan roams on, as a list. Empty when none are published.

region.description: Raw region value for a regional plan, e.g. "Europe". Null for a country plan.

region_label.description: The region formatted for a person to read. Null for a country plan.

retail_price_cents.description: Retail price in minor units (cents) of `currency`, so 1250 in EUR is 12.50 EUR. This is what a buyer pays for one eSIM.

retail_prices_cents.description: Prices in other currencies, keyed by ISO 4217 code, in minor units. Only the multi-currency surfaces (the catalog export) carry one, so it is absent here: read retail_price_cents and currency instead.

supports_tethering.description: Whether hotspot or tethering is allowed. Null means no supplier has declared it, which is not the same as "no".

supports_topup.description: Whether more data can be bought for the same eSIM once it runs low.

type.description: What the plan sells: data only, or data plus a bundled voice and SMS allowance.

validity_days.description: How many days the plan stays valid once it activates.

requested.description: The specification exactly as it was asked for.

data_mb.description: The data size as asked for, in megabytes; 0 means unlimited.

network.description: The network as asked for, or null for any network.

validity_days.description: The length as asked for, in days.

voice.description: Whether calls and texts are bundled as asked for.

title: Build an eSIM plan
